ticks.note: `R` while waiting: the strong abort restarts `WaitAB`, so the `A` of tick 2 is forgotten.
`B` alone gives no `O`: since the reset, only `B` has happened.
`A`: now both have happened since the reset, so `O` is emitted and the chart moves to `Done`.
`R` now does nothing: the abort belongs to `WaitAB`, which is no longer active, and `Done` has no transitions.
`A` and `B` are ignored too. This chart can emit `O` only once.
